data.name: Nkosinathi
data.gender_notes: Nkosinathi is used as a male name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Nkosinathi is a Zulu name meaning 'God's gift'. It is a popular name in Zulu culture and is often given to a child as a reminder of the blessings and gifts bestowed upon them by God. The name Nkosinathi carries the meaning “God's gift” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in Zulu. Parents who choose Nkosinathi usually hope their child will grow to embody god's gift and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Nkosinathi total 3, giving a life-path number of 3. Number 3 is linked with Jupiter and with the qualities of creativity, expression and optimism.

in_hebrew.name: נקוסינתי
in_hebrew.meaning: האלוהים נתן לי כוח או יכולת
in_hebrew.long_meaning: השם נקוסינתי הוא שילוב של שתי מילים: 'נקוסי' שפירושו אלוהים נתן לי, ו'נאתי' שפירושו כוח או יכולת. השם נגזר מהשפה האפריקאית והוא מקובל בקרב הנוצרים באפריקה. הוא מבטא את הרעיון של אלוהים המעניק כוח ויכולת לאדם.

in_greek.name: Νκοσιναθή
in_greek.long_meaning: Το όνομα Νκοσιναθή προέρχεται από την αφρικανική γλώσσα και σημαίνει 'Ο Θεός μου έδωσε δύναμη'. Στην παράδοση των Χριστιανών στην Αφρική, το όνομα αυτό συμβολίζει τη δύναμη και την προστασία που προσφέρει ο Θεός.

in_latin.name: Nkosinathi
in_latin.long_meaning: Nkosinathi, a name of African origin, translates to 'Deus mihi virtutem dedit' or 'God has given me strength'. In Christian tradition, this name reflects the belief in God's empowerment and providence.

in_english.name: Nkosinathi
in_english.meaning: God has given me strength or power
in_english.long_meaning: Nkosinathi is a Christian name of African origin, meaning 'God has given me strength or power'. This name reflects the Christian belief in God's empowerment and providence, symbolizing spiritual strength and resilience.
